changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: The application role keeps the partitions of auth_event without owning a table: partition maintenance creates and drops tables, so it runs as this function's owner, for auth_event alone.
changeSet.sql: CREATE FUNCTION public.maintain_auth_event_partitions() RETURNS void LANGUAGE sql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp AS $$ SELECT partman.run_maintenance(p_parent_table := 'public.auth_event') $$
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.maintain_auth_event_partitions() FROM PUBLIC
